title: Add better-auth to a node-app and its db package

backend.description: The project root of a node-app that the prisma generator wired to the db package, for example apps/backend.

db.description: The project root of the db package of the prisma generator, for example packages/db.

web.description: The project root of a react-app that reaches the backend through /api, for example apps/web. It gets the better-auth client, and the backend trusts its development origins.
